first_option: complete outbound only; unchanged geometry continuation replans at target; full return reservation and live guard retained
parent_aggregation: equal-weight mean of that parent's two predeclared matched decision pairs
aggregate: equal weight per parent, never per frame or candidate

development_training_screen.interpretation: engineering screen for whether training is worth attempting, not statistical significance, application acceptance or semantic model efficacy

negative_and_unmatched_states: retain; unmatched later states may be used for grouped development after this screen, never mislabel them as exact geometry-conditioned pairs
history_reuse: Existing geometrically matched V13.1 decision states and candidate pools; all V13.2 future outcomes must be newly executed.
comparison_to_v13: Paired development comparison of commitment horizon only, using all 8 prior-declared pairs and every common candidate. No efficacy claim from this post-hoc mechanism change.
pre_execution_requirements: Four-branch whole-budget smoke using Q0/shelf_east step 0 and 19, first and last candidate IDs in each pool, chosen as deterministic interface cases; not representative efficacy samples.
New physical replay must check the first-outbound contract, complete sensor trajectory, online return guard, final mesh and metrics.
Freeze dedicated collector/replayer sources before any V13.2 branch outcome.
Keep all failures and apply the same primary metric, total budget, parent weights, reference seeds and 0.5 percent engineering screen.
